tasks.label: HomeHub: Install Java 17
tasks.command: & { $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $destination = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'HomeHubToolchains\java17'; $jdk = Get-ChildItem $destination -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { Test-Path (Join-Path $_.FullName 'bin\java.exe') } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $jdk) { $release = (Invoke-RestMethod 'https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/17/hotspot?architecture=x64&image_type=jdk&os=windows&vendor=eclipse')[0]; $package = $release.binary.package; $archive = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'homehub-temurin17-task.zip'; & curl.exe --fail --location --retry 3 --output $archive $package.link; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Java download failed.' }; if ((Get-FileHash $archive -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $package.checksum) { throw 'Java archive checksum mismatch.' }; Expand-Archive -Path $archive -DestinationPath $destination; $jdk = Get-ChildItem $destination -Directory | Where-Object { Test-Path (Join-Path $_.FullName 'bin\java.exe') } | Select-Object -First 1 }; if (-not $jdk) { throw 'JDK installation failed.' }; & (Join-Path $jdk.FullName 'bin\java.exe') -version; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Java validation failed.' }; & "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\HomeHubToolchains\flutter\bin\flutter.bat" config --jdk-dir $jdk.FullName }
